_readme: Gentle spoken prompts at set times of day. Edit this file to change them;
nothing here is hardcoded in the program.
enabled  false switches one off without deleting it.
message  what is said. Keep it to one or two short sentences, warm and
plain - the same way the assistant talks the rest of the time.
MEDICATION entries are deliberately different. The assistant must never
tell anyone to take anything - that is medical instruction, which this
device does not do. A medication entry is only ever a check-in that offers
to involve a carer, and its wording is generated rather than taken from
this file so it cannot be edited into an instruction. Whatever the person
answers is ordinary conversation and is NOT recorded as proof they took
anything, because there is no way to know that.

routines.message: Morning. It's about the time you usually have breakfast.
It's around lunchtime. Fancy something to eat?
Nice afternoon. A little walk or a sit by the window might be lovely.
